hoverboard.config.poskp.unit: position: 0.1 rpm per hall step of error; 0/65535 = default 20

hoverboard.config.posrpm.unit: velocity limit (vel_limit) in position and velocity modes, rpm; 0/65535 = default 300

hoverboard.config.motorr.unit: phase resistance incl. mosfets, mOhm; 0/65535 = default 300

hoverboard.config.fwimax.unit: FOC field weakening: max negative d current 0.1 A; 0/65535 = off

hoverboard.config.fwadvance.unit: sine field weakening: max phase advance, degrees electrical; 0/65535 = off

hoverboard.config.itotalzero.unit: shunt zero below adc 0 (the adc clips), 0.01 counts; 0/65535 = 0

hoverboard.config.torqueconst.unit: torque constant mNm/A (CANSimple torque units); 0/65535 = 8270 / sine kv

hoverboard.config.curtrip.unit: phase current trip (current_hard_max) 0.1 A; 0/65535 = 2 x focimax, at least 15 A

hoverboard.config.inputmode.unit: ODrive input mode 1 PASSTHROUGH, 2 VEL_RAMP, 3 POS_FILTER, 5 TRAP_TRAJ, 6 TORQUE_RAMP; 0/65535 = 1

hoverboard.config.itotaldivider.unit: itotal = divider * Vadc (1/shunt ohm: R003 = 333; detect current with the shunt value)

hoverboard.config.pwmres.unit: TIM1 period 2048..16383 (17.6..2.2 kHz), read at boot; the control stays at ~4.39 kHz, FOC modulation limit 94 % at 8192, 76 % at 2048

hoverboard.config.softocp.unit: A, averaged bus current limit, 0 = off

hoverboard.config.hardocp.unit: adc watchdog current limit, adc counts above zero

hoverboard.config.drivemode.unit: commutation*4 + control: 0 COM_VOLT, 1 COM_SPEED, 4 SINE_VOLT, 5 SINE_SPEED, 3/7/11 COM/SINE/FOC_POSITION, 8 FOC_VOLT, 9 FOC_SPEED, 10 FOC_TORQUE (control 0 pwm, 1 speed, 2 torque, 3 position; commutation 0 block, 1 sine, 2 FOC)

hoverboard.config.batempty.unit: mV, <= 20000 disables the low battery cut-off

hoverboard.config.timeout.unit: ms without a command until speed = 0

hoverboard.config.speedkp.unit: COM_SPEED: 0.1 permille duty per rpm, 0 = default 50

hoverboard.config.speedki.unit: COM_SPEED: 0.1 permille duty per rpm*s, 0 = default 100

hoverboard.config.speedkv.unit: COM_SPEED feed forward: 0.1 rpm/V at 100% duty, 0 = default 355

hoverboard.config.speedd0.unit: COM_SPEED feed forward: dead band permille duty, 0 = default 53

hoverboard.config.sinekp.unit: SINE_SPEED: 0.1 permille modulation per rpm, 0 = default 5

hoverboard.config.sinekv.unit: SINE_SPEED feed forward: 0.1 rpm/V at 100% modulation, 0 = default 242

hoverboard.config.sined0.unit: SINE_SPEED feed forward: dead band permille, 0 = default 10

hoverboard.config.iphasegain.unit: FOC: 0.1 mA per adc count, 0 = default 515

hoverboard.config.iphasecfg.unit: FOC: phases on iphasea/b 0 = A,B 1 = B,C 2 = A,C; +4: adc rises with current into the motor

hoverboard.config.focimax.unit: FOC: phase current limit 0.1 A, 0 = default 100; trips at twice that

hoverboard.config.curkp.unit: FOC current loop: mV per A, 0 = default 400

hoverboard.config.curki.unit: FOC current loop: V per A*s, 0 = default 300

hoverboard.config.cfgversion.unit: config layout version, migrated at boot: 1 drive mode numbers, 2 baud/100, 3 input mode words reset

hoverboard.config.holdcurrent.unit: FOC position hold current (stiffness) 0.1 A, <= 90 % of focimax; 0/65535 = 40

hoverboard.config.holdenable.unit: FOC position hold: 1 off, 2 on; 0/65535 = on

hoverboard.config.holdwindow.unit: FOC position: hold within 0.01 hall step of the target; 0/65535 = 150

hoverboard.config.posaccel.unit: FOC position approach acceleration / braking 0.01 turns/s^2; 0/65535 = 2000

hoverboard.config.inertia.unit: torque feed forward of the trajectory acceleration 0.0001 Nm/(turn/s^2); 0/65535 = 0

hoverboard.config.vellimittol.unit: overspeed error above vel_limit times this, 0.01; 0/65535 = 120

hoverboard.config.poski.unit: position I: 0.1 rpm per (hall step * s), within 4 steps of the target; 0/65535 = 0 (off)

hoverboard.config.poskd.unit: position D: 0.01 rpm per rpm of speed error (trajectory - wheel); 0/65535 = 0 (off)

hoverboard.config.focspdkd.unit: FOC velocity D: 0.01 mA per rpm/s of the measured speed; 0/65535 = 0 (off)

hoverboard.config.sinekd.unit: SINE_SPEED D: 0.01 permille modulation per rpm/s of the measured speed; 0/65535 = 0 (off)

hoverboard.config.speedkd.unit: COM_SPEED D: 0.01 permille duty per rpm/s of the measured speed; 0/65535 = 0 (off)

hoverboard.config.buzzerpassive.unit: buzzer without its own oscillator, driven with 2.2 kHz: 1 off, 2 on; 0/65535 = off

hoverboard.config.chargelevel.unit: charger pin while the charger is connected: 1 low, 2 high; 0/65535 = high

hoverboard.config.chargepull.unit: charger pin input: 1 floating, 2 pull-up, 3 pull-down; 0/65535 = floating

hoverboard.config.chargelock.unit: no driving while the charger is connected: 1 off, 2 on; 0/65535 = off

hoverboard.config.imusda.unit: IMU I2C SDA (PinFinder detect imu); read by the firmware at 0x68/0x69 (InvenSense register map), after a restart

hoverboard.config.hallang1.unit: angle (65536 per electrical turn) where hall state 1 starts, rising angle (calibrate hall); 0/65535 = built-in

hoverboard.config.imumount.unit: IMU mounting (PinFinder calibrate imu): 1 + up*6 + forward, chip axes 0..5 = +x +y +z -x -y -z; 0/65535 = chip axes

hoverboard.config.imurestx.unit: IMU gravity when level (calibrate imu), chip x, int16, 1024 = 1 g: zero pitch and roll

hoverboard.config.imuresty.unit: IMU gravity when level, chip y

hoverboard.config.imurestz.unit: IMU gravity when level, chip z

hoverboard.config.ir1.unit: infrared foot sensor 1 (PinFinder detect ir; irmode)

hoverboard.config.irmode.unit: foot sensors, 4 bits each (ir1 bits 0-3, ir2 4-7): level while covered 1 low / 2 high (default high), + 4 x input 1 floating / 2 pull-up / 3 pull-down

hoverboard.config.holdidle.unit: smart FOC position hold: d current at the target after holdidledelay, 0.1 A; pushed off the current rises again, full hold_current at 1.5 hall steps; 0/65535 = off (hold_current all the time)

hoverboard.config.holdidledelay.unit: smart hold: ms in the target's hall sector before the current falls to holdidle (~4.4 A/s); 0/65535 = 500

hoverboard.charger_connected.unit: 1 while the charger is connected (charge pin; also heartbeat byte 7 bit 0)

hoverboard.foot_sensors.unit: bit 0 / 1: infrared foot sensor ir1 / ir2 covered (PinFinder detect ir); also heartbeat byte 7 bits 1-2

axis0.controller.config.pos_gain.unit: (turns/s)/turn: position loop; FOC default 20, then the hold within 1.5 hall steps

axis0.controller.config.vel_gain.unit: Nm/(turns/s), FOC velocity loop; 0 = default (position mode 3.3x the velocity mode's)

axis0.config.watchdog_timeout.unit: s without a set point -> 0 / hold position

config.dc_bus_undervoltage_trip_level.unit: V, low battery cut-off; <= 20 V off

axis0.config.can.node_id.unit: the bus id (slave id), after a restart

hoverboard.foc.field_weakening_current.unit: A, max negative d current at the voltage limit (FOC); 0 = off, at most 90 % of current_soft_max

hoverboard.sine.field_weakening_advance.unit: degrees electrical, max phase advance beyond 100 % modulation (sine); 0 = off

axis0.controller.vel_setpoint.unit: turns/s, after the input mode (position: feed forward)

hoverboard.foc.Id_measured.unit: A, d current (FOC, sine on phase current pins), ~7 ms average

hoverboard.position.hold_current.unit: A, FOC position hold stiffness (d current at the target angle); default 4, at most 90 % of current_soft_max

hoverboard.position.hold_window.unit: hall steps: the hold takes over within this of the target (and below 25 rpm); default 1.5

hoverboard.position.accel_limit.unit: turns/s^2, FOC position approach acceleration and braking curve; default 20

axis0.controller.config.inertia.unit: Nm/(turn/s^2): torque feed forward of the TRAP_TRAJ / POS_FILTER acceleration (FOC); default 0

axis0.controller.config.vel_limit_tolera.unit: overspeed error above vel_limit times this; default 1.2

axis0.config.motor.phase_inductance.unit: H, FOC decoupling and current_control_bandwidth; default 0.00046

hoverboard.position.hold_enable.unit: 1 = hold at the target's electrical angle (FOC position), 0 = position loop only; default 1

axis0.controller.config.enable_torque_mo.unit: 1 = torque control limits the speed to vel_limit (torque falls with vel_gain); default 1

hoverboard.controller.pos_integrator_gai.unit: ((turns/s)/turn)/s: position I, within 4 hall steps of the target; default 0 (off)

hoverboard.controller.pos_derivative_gai.unit: (turns/s)/(turns/s): position D on trajectory speed - wheel speed; default 0 (off)

hoverboard.controller.vel_derivative_gai.unit: Nm/(turns/s^2): FOC velocity D on the measured speed (20 ms filter); default 0 (off)

axis0.config.motor.current_control_bandw.unit: rad/s: sets the current loop gains kp = L*bw, ki = R*bw (reads back kp / L); default gains ~870

hoverboard.imu.state.unit: 0 no IMU configured (imusda/imuscl/imuaddr 0x68/0x69), 1 running, 2 no answer

hoverboard.imu.accel_x.unit: m/s^2 (+-4 g), 100 Hz, board axes after calibrate imu (X forward, Y left, Z up; else the chip's); NaN unless running

hoverboard.imu.gyro_x.unit: deg/s (+-1000), board axes, bias from the first 0.5 s standing still

hoverboard.imu.pitch.unit: deg, front down positive, 0 = the level of calibrate imu (gyro + accelerometer, 0.5 s)

hoverboard.imu.roll.unit: deg, right side down positive, 0 = the level of calibrate imu

save_configuration.unit: store everything (when the wheel stands still)
